title: Phase I Environmental Site Assessment
description: A Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) report under ASTM E1527, as used by lenders, buyers, property owners and their counsel in real estate due diligence: the property assessed, who assessed it and when, the dates that govern the report's viability, the regulatory database search, nearby release sites, and the environmental professional's findings.

report.description: Who prepared the report, for whom, and when.

site_name.description: Name of the assessed site as printed on the cover.

site_address.description: Location or street address of the assessed site, including city, state and ZIP code.

prepared_for.description: The organization named under 'Prepared for' on the cover.

client.description: The organization the executive summary says retained the consultant (the 'Client').

consultant.description: The environmental consulting firm that prepared the report.

consultant_project_number.description: The consultant's project number for this assessment.

date_issued.description: Date the report was issued, from the cover.

viability_date.description: Date through which the report is presumed viable, from the cover.

astm_standard.description: The ASTM standard practice the assessment was performed under, as cited in the executive summary, e.g. 'E 1527-21'.

environmental_professional.description: Name of the Environmental Professional under whose supervision the assessment was conducted.

property.description: The subject property and its physical setting.

apn.description: Assessor's parcel number (APN) of the subject property or its parent parcel.

acreage.description: Size of the subject property in acres.

parent_parcel_acreage.description: Size in acres of the larger parent parcel, when the subject property is a portion of one.

current_use.description: Current use of the subject property.

site_elevation.description: Site elevation as stated in the physical setting section, with units.

fema_flood_panel.description: FEMA flood insurance rate map panel number for the subject property.

earliest_record_year.description: Earliest year back to which reviewed records documented the use of the property, as stated in the executive summary.

first_developed_use_year.description: Year of the property's first developed use, as stated in the executive summary.

component_dates.description: The dates of the ASTM E1527-21 Section 4.6 components, from the executive summary's component dates table. These govern the report's viability.

government_records_review.description: Date of the review of government records.

visual_inspection.description: Date of the visual inspection (site reconnaissance).

ep_declaration.description: Date given for the declaration by the Environmental Professional.

site_reconnaissance.description: The site visit, from the reconnaissance information table.

limitations.description: Any limitations on access during the reconnaissance.

regulatory_database_search.description: One entry per row of the regulatory records review table: each database searched, its search distance and the number of sites found.

agency_type.description: Regulatory agency type as printed, e.g. 'Federal', 'State & Tribal' or 'Either'.

search_distance.description: Approximate minimum search distance (AMSD), e.g. '1 mile' or 'Subject Property and adjoining properties'.

sites_found.description: Number of sites found within the search distance.

nearby_sites.description: One entry per facility discussed in the adjoining and nearby sites table.

gradient.description: Position relative to groundwater flow, e.g. 'up-gradient'.

distance_ft.description: Approximate distance from the subject property in feet.

direction.description: Direction of the facility from the subject property.

case_number.description: GeoTracker case or global ID number.

case_status.description: Case status, e.g. 'closed LUST Cleanup Site' or 'open cleanup program site'.

contaminant_of_concern.description: Contaminant of concern, e.g. gasoline, diesel or metals.

is_rec.description: True if the report considers this facility a recognized environmental condition (REC or CREC) for the subject property.

findings.description: The environmental professional's findings and opinions.

recs_identified.description: True if any recognized environmental conditions (RECs) were identified in connection with the subject property.

items.description: Short name of the CREC, e.g. the source facility.

hrecs_identified.description: True if any historical recognized environmental conditions (HRECs) were identified.

vapor_encroachment_condition.description: Conclusion of the Tier 1 vapor encroachment screening, in brief.
